caption: Red and white paint on a paper plate are swirled together with a brush, and the swirl turns pink.

sa.check: Red and white paint sit on a paper plate.
The colours are separate first, then swirled, then pink.

pc.expect: The pink spreads from the brush through the paint where the brush blends the two, streaks becoming uniform and never gathers back; coloured areas stay coloured.
pc.fail: The paint returns to its original colour where it was pink; or the pink gathers back into the brush; or the pink appears before the brush arrives.

pc.expect: The result is pink, and un-reached paint keeps its original colour.
pc.fail: The paint turns a colour other than pink; or the un-reached paint changes; or the pink is darker than the brush itself.

pc.expect: The paint behaves as it should: streaks and swirls where stirred or spread, settling where it flows.
pc.fail: The paint is rigid and unmarked; or it flows like water when it is a paste; or it bounces like rubber.

pc.expect: The paint moves only where stirred or where the pink flows.
pc.fail: The paint swirls by itself; or the pink spreads faster than stirring or flow carries it; or the container moves.

pc.expect: The amount of paint stays the same and the container keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The container fills or empties on its own; or a second container appears; or the brush passes through the container.

pc.expect: The container and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The container changes colour; or the background rearranges; or the tool changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
